review.decision: Proceed with isolated store, relay and guarded dispatcher cases
review.notes: Observe reply and fetch independently of request ingestion and Stop order. Ordinary reply is pull-only. A separate current-revision HQ workspace action binds an existing reviewed step, a sourced user instruction, exact execution member and a specific inbox reply. Reserve the original intent ID, including across crashes. Use only guarded native idle wake, never forward a body. An exact source progress receipt with evidence is required for execution. Design review by the author only.

cases.description: Inbox lifecycle and worker proof survive races and restarts.
cases.setup: Isolated workspace, relay facts, exact execution member and saved intent.
cases.action: Ingest request before and after Stop, repeat scans, fetch and supply late structured source receipts.
cases.expected: Request, reply, hint, fetch and actual work are distinct. Both unfetched and fetched without execution remain visible. A queue or input receipt cannot prove work.

cases.description: An explicit workspace continuation reserves one current authorized step.
cases.setup: Isolated durable store and synthetic Codex candidates and native RPC adapter.
cases.action: Arm through the HQ action, restart, race or repeat scheduling and inject wrong authority, target changes, user question, busy, draft, refusal and uncertain submission.
cases.expected: Only one exact idle native transport can receive the bounded receipt-specific reminder. No implicit grant, fallback, stale replay or second submission; blockers and original attempt remain inspectable.
